"There is no such thing as a single-issue struggle, because we do not live single-issue lives."

You're never too young to be an ally!

Nolan Davis, age 8, organized a #BLM march. He said, "I'm worried about Black people, like me, getting hurt. Some skin is like chocolate. Some is like vanilla. Some is mixed together like mine. But we're all people."
